posts.text:
trump’s iran policy is utterly incoherent. he’s angry about not having an off-ramp and a personal win…and this is the result. 

the american people deserve better.

the most consequential decision of trump’s presidency.
war with iran.
troops deploying.
and the president still hasn't explained the strategy.
@gzeromedia

Video

month two of the iran war.
more troops.
more escalation.
and ground operations looking very likely.
@gzeromedia

Video

coal stocks since the iran war started: whitehaven up 70%. yancoal up 40%. core natural resources up 30%.
 
japan and south korea are bringing old coal plants back online to replace lost middle east energy. experts warn that once you restart a coal plant, shutting it back down is politically nearly impossible.
the iran war needs $200 billion. congress is looking at health care to find it. cbo says one proposal alone leaves 300,000 more americans uninsured.

trump is now negotiating with what he calls "a new, and more reasonable, regime" in iran. simultaneously threatening to blow up iran's power plants, oil wells, kharg island, and — possibly — desalination plants.

the global trading system is quietly repricing around a world where the strait of hormuz is a war zone.

not a headline.
the new baseline.

a surprisingly good month for putin. 

russia making bank on oil, gas. fertilizer. us sanctions suspended. us weapons now prioritized for iran war. russia supporting iran without consequence. and a russian tanker with oil now allowed through to cuba by the americans.

trump can’t reopen the strait of hormuz with an air campaign. and the iranians aren’t going to accept that outcome willingly. 

ground troops are coming.
